elysiumcore.welcomescreen.wiki: Please read the wiki first for recommended tweaks, gameplay changes, and known issues.
elysiumcore.welcomescreen.accessibility: This modpack is designed with motion sickness in mind. View bobbing, FOV effects, damage tilt, and distortion effects are disabled by default. You can turn them back on in Accessibility Settings.
elysiumcore.welcomescreen.multiplayer: Multiplayer is built in. Open your world to LAN and send the IP shown in chat to your friends. Voice chat is included too: hold G to talk and they will hear you. Hold N to talk in group chats. Press Y to mute yourself.
elysiumcore.tip.secret_story: If you want to learn about this story, message Fyoncle on Discord.
elysiumcore.portal_denied: Flint and steel won't work. Use a Dimensional Tear Bottle, found in ruined portals.
